name: cd-collab
description: Separately deployable collaboration and case-memory layer (working name; rename-friendly).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run build -w @cd-collab/web && npm run build -w @cd-collab/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @cd-collab/server && npm run typecheck -w @cd-collab/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run lint -w @cd-collab/server && npm run lint -w @cd-collab/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run test -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run test -w @cd-collab/server && npm run test -w @cd-collab/web
scripts.demo: npm run build -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run build:demo -w @cd-collab/web && npm run demo -w @cd-collab/server
scripts.demo:static: npm run build -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run build:demo -w @cd-collab/web && npm run demo:static -w @cd-collab/server
scripts.demo:check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run demo:static
scripts.qualify: npm run build -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run qualify -w @cd-collab/server
scripts.config:init: npm run build -w @cd-collab/contracts && npm run build -w @cd-collab/server && node server/dist/config-init-cli.js
